children.title: Activities and day-trips within 30 km of Baiersbronn
children.summary: A trip-planner's tour of the Northern Black Forest within ~30 km of Baiersbronn — Genießerpfade hikes, the B500 high road, Freudenstadt, Allerheiligen waterfalls, Alpirsbach brewery, and the Bad Wildbad treetops.

children.title: Walking-distance lodging covering Baiersbronn's starred restaurants
children.summary: Baiersbronn's eight Michelin stars sit in three different valleys; no single lodging puts all of them on foot. Tonbach (Hotel Traube Tonbach) wins for stars-per-walk.

children.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Baiersbronn
children.summary: Baiersbronn holds two ★★★ restaurants — Schwarzwaldstube and Bareiss — and no ★★ in the current Guide; here is how to choose between them and book.

children.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Baiersbronn
children.summary: Inside a strict 30 km circle the only recurring IT event is the IHK Nordschwarzwald 'Innovation Breakfast' AI series in Nagold; for an actual conference, WFCS 2026 in Offenburg (~32 km) and the 112. Datenschutzkonferenz in Bad Herrenalb (~33 km) sit just outside the line.
